source: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL
notes: Source is OpenStreetMap only. rpt.sa returned HTTP 403 and the open.data.gov.sa dataset search returned HTTP 400, so no official GTFS or stop list was found.
Overpass mirror used: https://maps.mail.ru/osm/tools/overpass/api/interpreter (overpass-api.de and overpass.kumi.systems returned 504 or timed out). OSM base timestamp 2026-10-12T11:31:36Z.

Metro: 96 OSM station elements merged into 83 stations (elements within 200 m, or same English name within 700 m). All have Arabic and English names. Lines come from the ref of OSM subway route relations whose stops lie within 300 m. Stations per line: line 1: 25, line 2: 15, line 3: 22, line 4: 9, line 5: 12, line 6: 11.
The metro station count could not be checked against an official figure: https://www.rcrc.gov.sa/en/projects/riyadh-metro/ returned a Page not found page and rpt.sa blocked the request.

Some OSM metro names look wrong and need review, for example the Arabic names of the three airport stations (digits placed before the word) and names that carry the word for station while others do not.

Excluded 14 ways tagged station=light_rail with placeholder names such as Metro Station A7. They sit on the OSM route named Princess Nora bint Abdul Rahman University Automated People Mover, not on a numbered metro line.
Train: 2 named stations kept. Dropped 1 railway=station element(s) with no name or other tags: n2846344497. Riyadh North railway station has no operator tag in OSM.

Bus stations: 23 kept after merging 3 duplicates (compatible names within 60 m). 13 have no name at all, 17 lack an Arabic name, 15 lack an English name. OSM uses amenity=bus_station for both terminals and enclosed BRT stations.

Bus stops: 518 kept after dropping 45 duplicates (compatible names within 15 m). 180 have no name at all, 244 lack an Arabic name, 380 lack an English name. Only 68 carry route refs, taken from OSM bus route relations that list the stop as a member.
OSM bus coverage could not be checked against an official stop list. With 518 stops mapped and many unnamed, treat the bus layer as likely partial.
The ref field holds the OSM ref tag as mapped (metro station codes such as 1J1, or a bus stop number). Most entries have none.
